reason: E1 supports the general lubricity of layered 2D materials like MoS2, but none of the cited evidence demonstrates sulfur ion implantation or sulfide film formation on CoCrFeMnNi. Key premises about the specific intervention, temperature range, and self-healing lack direct support.
